title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 7, section 50 (Spatsizi Plateau Wilderness Park)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 7 No Hunting Areas (Section 8)
Spatsizi Plateau Wilderness Park
50 That portion of M.U. 6-20 within the boundaries of Spatsizi Plateau Wilderness Park known locally as the Danahue Pass Trail corridor. [en. B.C. Reg. 151/2006, s. 5 (d).]
